purpose: Teach: 表象/場内/別館/採集/持ち出す/取り返し/備考/呼びかける

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社のロゴ、本気で、絶対、ブランドの表象として、絶対、大切に、しましょうね、本気で、本気、絶対、本当に、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Our company logo is something we need to treasure as a core brand symbol. Truly, it matters.
lines.style: Formal, measured cadence. Opens with steady authority. Each phrase lands with quiet emphasis—not rushed, but deliberate. A manager laying down principle without aggression.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。イベントの場内、本気で、絶対、お客様、満足、本気で、絶対、いただける空間、整えます、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure the event venue becomes a space where our customers feel genuinely satisfied and cared for.
lines.style: Respectful agreement. Leans into the affirmative—warm but official. Steady tempo. The tone of someone committing to a standard they believe in, not just complying.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 別館の利用、本気で、絶対、社員、皆、お互いに、本気で、配慮しましょうね、本気で、本気、絶対、本当に、感謝、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: When we use the annex, we need everyone to be considerate of each other. I really appreciate that commitment.
lines.style: Directive but not cold. Settles on 'considerate' with gentle firmness. Paces to allow the instruction to land. Ends with gratitude that sounds genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧客データの採集、本気で、絶対、法に基づき、絶対、慎重に、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Understood. We'll handle customer data collection carefully and strictly according to the law. Thank you for that guidance.
lines.style: Composed, methodical. Emphasizes 'carefully' and 'according to the law' without sounding anxious—these are non-negotiables stated as routine. Warm close.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内情報、本気で、絶対、社外に、絶対、持ち出すこと、ないよう、社員、徹底してね、本気で、本気、絶対、本当に、感謝、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Internal information must not leave this building. I need everyone to be rigorous about that. I'm grateful for your diligence.
lines.style: Clear, steady authority. Lands hard on 'must not'—not angry, but non-negotiable. Slight pause before the gratitude. The tone of someone who trusts the team but is stating what matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取り返しのつかない、本気で、絶対、ミス、避けるよう、社員、皆、本気で、絶対、心がけております、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. All our staff are focused on preventing mistakes that can't be undone. We take that very seriously.
lines.style: Assured, almost matter-of-fact. Opens with 'Yes' as acknowledgment. Speaks 'irreparable mistake' without melodrama—it's simply the standard. Calm, professional conviction.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 書類の備考、本気で、絶対、確認、徹底してね、本気で、本気、絶対、本当に、感謝、しております、本気で、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Everyone needs to verify the remarks section of documents thoroughly. I truly appreciate that level of care.
lines.style: Direct instruction delivered with quiet emphasis. 'Thoroughly' lands with weight. Soft but sincere on the gratitude—not obligatory phrasing, actual recognition of effort.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、コミュニケーション、呼びかける、雰囲気、絶対、作ってまいります、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. We'll keep building a workplace culture where staff feel encouraged to communicate openly with each other.
lines.style: Warm close. Softer than previous lines. Opens collaborative—'we'll keep building' suggests ongoing partnership. Paces with ease. The closing tone of someone summing up shared values.
